problem: Improve the sample and wall-clock efficiency of reinforcement learning directly from continuous-control images.
contribution: DrQ-v2 is an efficient image-based actor-critic implementation using random shifts, deterministic policy gradients, n-step returns, scheduled exploration and replay/hyperparameter changes.
algorithm: Encode augmented image stacks; train twin critics with n-step targets and minimum target-Q; update a deterministic actor while stopping encoder gradients from the actor loss. Use clipped Gaussian exploration and a schedule; retain current rather than target encoder weights.
observations: Three consecutive84×84RGB observations stacked to recover temporal information; random shifts use4pixel replicated padding and bilinear interpolation.
actions: Continuous simulator control actions with action repeat2; environment frames and actor steps are explicitly different quantities.
embodiment_and_data: 24DeepMind Control/MuJoCo tasks grouped by difficulty, including21DOF humanoid. Online simulated replay; not physical manipulation demonstrations.
experiments: All compared algorithms use a single NVIDIA V100 and evaluations every20K environment steps. Each evaluation averages10episodes; curves show means over10training seeds with95%confidence regions. Easy/medium/hard budgets differ.
baselines: SAC, CURL and DrQ, with implementation and component/hyperparameter comparisons. Wall-clock comparisons are controlled on the source hardware.

quantitative_result.value: Implementation throughput increases from28to96environment frames/s on the same source hardware, reported about3.5× faster; not an NX benchmark or task-success rate.
quantitative_result.location: PDF p3 opening implementation paragraph; p6 Section4.1 specifies V100 evaluation setup

limitations: Results concern simulator returns and long online-interaction budgets. Faster training partly comes from implementation/hyperparameter changes; reproducing just an image augmentation does not reproduce the complete algorithm. Augmentation does not solve contact observability or missing joint feedback.
code_and_license: Paper links facebookresearch/drqv2, but executable code/license were not audited here. Do not assume that code was installed or executed.
hardware_adaptation: Useful future visual-RL comparator and image/replay engineering reference; profile actual NX memory, update latency and rollout throughput. Preserve image history and report environment versus decision-step units.
